tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Every model Kottos AI lists prices for, with how many venue and service tier offers sell it and how many of them the live probe measures. Its names are the ones compare_venues accepts.

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description: For one model, each venue and service tier that sells it: list prices in US dollars per million tokens and, where the probe measures it, time to first token over the last hour.
